final_response_fingerprint.details: Read-only independent review (no cargo, no source edits, no git writes) of OpenSpec change keep-shared-daemon-resident. Use `git diff` (ignore src/cli/terminal.rs, another session's) and the new file crates/jcode-tui/src/tui/app/server_status.rs. Compare with openspec/changes/keep-shared-daemon-resident/{proposal.md,specs/**,tasks.md}. FIRST create scratch/applyall/review-keep-daemon.md with a skeleton, and append findings every few minutes (server reloads kill workers). Check: (1) the shared daemon can never idle-exit or return EXIT_IDLE_TIMEOUT (server.rs IdleExit, lifecycle.rs); temporary servers keep owner-PID and idle exit and now also require no ambient/background work (WorkPresence); an unreadable ambient/background answer must fail toward alive; (2) SIGTERM/reload: begin_shutdown ordering, cancel_shutdown on refused reload and the JCODE_TEST_SESSION skip, and whether the final exec/failure paths in reload.rs leave admission closed or open correctly (the process exits(42) after failed exec: is that consistent?); non-zero exit when the save drain was incomplete (is exit 1 under systemd Restart=always a problem, or does it contradict 'exits cleanly'?); (3) admission gates actually in place: swarm spawn (comm_session.rs), ambient runner loop (runner.rs), are there other new-work paths that should check shutting_down but do not, and can the ambient runner spin or deadlock while shutting down after a refused reload; (4) registry client count publisher (5s task) and ServerInfo.clients compat with old registry files; (5) /servers TUI and `server status` CLI: stale cleanup, malformed/future started_at, cell-width truncation (look for wide chars and width 0/1 edge cases), no wrapping; (6) tasks.md honesty: especially task 1.5 mentions 'remains alive under Restart=always' and 'reload preserves pending work' — what do the tests really prove vs a unit-level proxy; flag any overstated box. Classify findings blocker/major/minor with file:line. End with `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes-requested` and `REVIEW COMPLETE`.
